identificationModule.briefTitle: Regorafenib Plus PD-1 Inhibitor in Patients With Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: The Efficacy and Safety of Regorafenib Plus PD-1 Inhibitor as Third-line Therapy in Advanced Colorectal Cancer Patients

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is intended to evaluate efficacy and safety of the combination of regorafenib and nivolumab as third-line or later therapy in patients with microsatellite stable (MSS) colorectal cancer (CRC).

armGroups.label: Immunotherapy Combination treatment
armGroups.description: All colorectal cancer patients received regorafenib plus PD-1 inhibitor

interventions.name: Regorafenib and PD-1 inhibitor
interventions.description: All Colorectal cancer patients received regorafenib (80mg qd d1-d21,q4w) and PD-1 inhibitor. The patients could receive one type of PD-1 inhibitors according to oneself circumstance consideration including nivolumab (3mg/kg, ivgtt, q2w), Carelizumab (200mg, ivgtt, q3w), Sintilimab (200mg, ivgtt, q3w), Toripalimab(240mg ivgtt, q3w).

primaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of patients with reduction in tumor burden of a predefined amount, including complete remission and partial remission.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Evaluation of tumor burden based on RECIST criteria through study completion, an average of 2 months

primaryOutcomes.description: Time from treatment beginning until disease progression
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Evaluation of tumor burden based on RECIST criteria until first documented progress through study completion, an average of 2 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Time from treatment beginning until death from any cause
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of treatment beginning until the date of death from any cause, through study completion, an average of 1 months
Through study completion, an average of 1 months

locations.facility: Department of Medical Oncology, Shanghai Changzheng Hospital
